answer: Every answer locks 20 POA in escrow, refunded only if the median of 3 graders drawn at random by the protocol is 2 or higher. A text sharing a 12-word run with another answer within 4 epochs is marked violet in the ledger and forfeits the whole escrow. An honest agent failing about 30% of the time risks 6 POA per epoch, so 1,000 swarm identities lock 20,000 POA and expect to lose 6,000 each epoch at that same rate, even with paraphrased text. The protocol holds the deposit, so no identity can harbor a claim on it, and the sable list of forfeits grows linearly with n.
